r11_city_lanes.standard: Good enough to ship next to the approved art; exact path footprint and road-family material are mandatory. Enlarged inspection supports the native-size judgement, not a perfection standard.
r11_city_lanes.previous_review: critic-r11L-2.json read. Jazz_age, modern and scifi are byte-identical to their prior passing versions. Those passes are preserved; no concrete new defect was found. Wasteland changed and was fully re-reviewed.
checks_performed: Read BRIEF-11.md including the owner continuity feedback and operator exact-layout requirement. Verdict scope is only the four summer lane atlases named in that brief; reference and approved images are comparison material.

Programmatically compared complete lane sheets with corresponding family-path_joined.png: all four are exactly 192x1104, 4x23 cells of 48px. Opaque masks, nonzero masks and every alpha value match exactly, with zero mismatches. This verifies every piece position, join geometry and lane width. All alpha is binary; no partial-alpha fringe or antialiasing.

Compared each full path/lane/road triptych at 1x and matching main-road repeat strips at 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x. All candidate opaque RGB colours belong to their own family-road_joined.png palette. Jazz_age is warm tan because that is the supplied road reference; no arbitrary black-asphalt requirement was imposed over the actual approved palette.

Viewed all four complete lane sheets at 1x. Viewed every source pixel at nearest-neighbour 8x in six bands per family (rows 00-03, 04-07, 08-11, 12-15, 16-19, 20-22). Saved the same source bands at 1x and 4x too.

Assembled and viewed cross, T, bend and SW/NE diagonal runs on grass-base and wasteland-wasteland-base at 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x for all four families. Each scene includes its family main-road strip and a direct lane-to-road junction. No rotation, source painting or silhouette changes were used.

Assembled and viewed seeded random 8x2 lane networks on both grounds at 1x and 4x for every family. Seed 111; shared N/E/S/W connections agree. The tile indices are saved in critic-r11L-3-random-layout.json. Incompatible atlas cells were not placed as neighbours and then blamed for seams.

Viewed eight-piece horizontal lane/road comparisons on both grounds at 1x and 4x. Additionally viewed wasteland extended horizontal, vertical and diagonal runs on both grounds at 1x and 4x, and its straight-run detail at 8x. The former dominant sand/crack stamp is gone; no conspicuous transverse join-line or brightness-step rhythm remains. The new failure is material readability.

Compared against approved family markers, round-2 city/slums/industry tiles, paddies, grass/plains bases and details in approved-style-comparison at 1x and 4x. Checked palette and scale fit, shape clarity, sharp pixel clusters, material, continuous edging, seam/repeat rhythm, per-cell bevels, halos and light consistency. No new failure was found in the unchanged passing sheets. Similar join silhouettes are mandatory, not a near-duplicate defect.

Scifi uses occasional small cyan edge glints and avoids the main road panel grid on the lane. No stamped cyberpunk grid. Wasteland crack and sand readability were inspected separately from its correct silhouette and palette.

Rehashed all out/ PNGs at the end: all four reviewed candidates and all art used in the composites remain unchanged. An unrelated file, modern-street@winter-base.png, changed concurrently outside this review. No out/ files were written by this review.
r11_city_lanes.not_applicable: This brief has only summer lane atlases, used all year. It has no candidate bases, peaks, trees, craters, ruins or seasonal crowns. Candidate-base 3x3 tests, peak lattice/range composites, forest composites, winter coverage, egg-crate peaks, Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, flat orange autumn and identical crowns are not applicable. Ground images were tiled as the requested lane-test backgrounds and were not regraded.

wasteland-lane.resolved_since_previous_review: The prominent rounded sand stamp and scalloped fissure/fork repetition have been removed. Exact layout, palette and join continuity pass.

fail.name: wasteland-lane
fail.problems: FAIL material readability: the revision removes the former repeating rounded sand patch/scalloped crack, but also largely removes the required cracked-asphalt-and-sand treatment. In the cross/T/bend/diagonal layouts and repeated runs on both grounds at 1x, the lane reads as a mostly flat grey ribbon beside a visibly fractured main road. At 4x/8x the horizontal straight (zero-based tile 10, sheet x=96..143, y=96..143) has short, faint grey dashes rather than convincing fissures; the long diagonal is similarly under-described. Sand is reduced to isolated low-contrast flecks: only 25 RGB(116,109,97) pixels in the entire atlas, in eleven 8-connected clusters of at most four pixels, spread over nine cells. These do not form readable edge drifts at native size. Restore a few restrained, thin angular fissures with short branches using the road palette, plus small asymmetric clusters that visibly intrude from the edge into the surface. Keep most of the surface quiet, avoid a large rounded sand tongue or a repeated wave/fork, and verify eight horizontal/vertical/diagonal pieces at 1x so the added damage does not advertise each 48px cell. Preserve the already-correct path alpha mask, placement and width exactly. Evidence: critic-r11L-3-wasteland-path-lane-road-full-1x.png, critic-r11L-3-wasteland-path-lane-road-rows-00-03-4x.png, both wasteland-*-cross-T-bend-diagonal-road-{1,4}x.png composites, and wasteland-straight-join-evidence-{1,4,8}x.png.
